decisions.reason: After two years on the market, the evening psychiatric day-patient program reflects visible investment in a core therapeutic field, so management is very likely to continue and interpret any remaining weaknesses as temporary.
The carpentry workshop has already received a dedicated launch and fits the firm's rehabilitation and production capabilities, which encourages continued commitment rather than reversal.
Although the outpatient sociotherapy service was less prominently presented, it is close to the firm's established care model and surviving another year increases the tendency to persist.
The counseling service for senior living combines strong public visibility with close alignment to the eldercare portfolio, making withdrawal within the next year unlikely.
The meal delivery service for seniors is newer and less visibly committed than the others, but its proximity to the core clientele and the firm's expansionary stance still favor keeping it for now.
